Static acceptance — snapshot `FBC5FF…` (file hashes as listed, not re-verified here):

* Narrative: pass — 6 lines / 5 beats: wake-up → parcel intact → deliver to Pecúnia → Pendergast blocks reception → Gepeto service entry → door to patio.
* Atlas contract (static): pass/qualified — code sets `Iris hframes=6`, `Ampere hframes=7`, `offset(-48,-81)`, foot `~220` vs floor `219`, `ExitGlow x=500` vs door `x500`, `Backdrop 576x324`. PNG pixel size / foot `y81` / frame semantics not verifiable without assets — runtime copy test still needed.
* Animation tied-to-story: pass — `0 kneel→1 reach→2 recoil→3 rise→4 stand→5 point`; `0 off→1 flicker→2 brace→3 knee→4 stand→5 bend+hide parcel→6 holding`; beat 2 `BlockedMark`, beat 3 `Gepeto+ExitGlow/Arrow`, beat 4 point.
* Skip / advance / transitions / single-view / retry / no side-effects: pass — `Skip+ESC→_finish_intro`, `Advance+ENTER/SPACE/click gated by _line_ready+_in_progress`, `SceneTree meta intro_completed_this_session` set only on `change OK`, `main_menu` falls through to lobby if intro missing, failure path sets `_lobby_load_failed`, `TENTAR DE NOVO`, both buttons retry, no save/gameplay state touched.
* Focus: qualified — menu circular `neighbors+previous/next` + exit-prompt focus correct; intro only `advance.focus_next→skip` + `skip.focus_previous→advance`, no arrow `neighbors`, no initial `grab_focus` until first `_unlock_line` (ESC still skips).
* Genuine parser/API misuse: none confirmed — `BitmapText.new() as HudBitmapText`, `in [KEY_…]`, `get_path_to→focus_next`, `Color(fill)`, `PackedVector2Array` flat lists, tween kill on finish all look correct; `HudBitmapText` requires `class_name` in `bitmap_text.gd` — confirm in runtime copy.
